title: Booking territories and Thomas's best region
summary: He explains how agencies divided territories and why his Richmond to Buffalo territory was the best in the country.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: That's right. So what happened is that you could book him in one town, and then somebody else would book him in another town.
Well, you see, we had territories. See, I had Richmond, Virginia, all the way up to Boston, all the way out to...
The agent that you worked for had that.

Yes. That was my territory. And I found out mathematically that I had the best territory in the whole United States. Because I had the biggest towns within a short...a certain distance... I had (?) Washington and Trenton (I booked the college in Trenton), I had New York, and then I had New Haven, I had Boston, I had Albany, and my last town I booked would be Buffalo -- then the Midwest would take it over.
Who carved(?) the territory up like that?

Well, the agent, they'd divide it up like that. See, they had a Southern territory, and the Southern territory could latch in to the Eastern territory. See, like, you could play Winston-Salem, and then jump into
Well, some agencies got it together like they got in (?), and booked them (?).
Billy Shaw. Billy Shaw did that.
